Title: Good Tidings of Peace for Judah
Promise: Good tidings of peace would be brought to Judah, her feasts kept and vows performed, for the wicked would no longer pass through her, being utterly cut off. Doubt: Judah's deliverance here is an implied consequence of Nineveh's fall, not a standalone commitment addressed to Judah; the feast-keeping is a command rather than a promise condition, so the entry would rest on implication.
